html:
tokentrim pro $49 lifetime

Yes, you can buy the Tokentrim Pro lifetime license for a one‑time $49 payment. After purchase you get the hosted dashboard, weekly budget alerts, Slack totals and the ability to run Pro on up to three machines.

How it works for a single developer who wants a persistent dashboard

  1. Install the full Tokentrim toolkit via git clone (requires Python 3.9+).
  2. Activate the Pro license (enter the code you receive after purchase).
  3. Open the hosted dashboard on any device – it shows your Claude Code token usage, daily budget guard and cold‑cache alerts.
  4. The dashboard updates automatically; you can also run the replay command to see your own savings numbers.

What you get and what it costs

  • Free features – all Claude Code hooks, three strength profiles, replay command, local dashboard, daily budget guard, cold‑cache alert.
  • Pro lifetime upgrade – $49 one‑time payment (first 500 buyers). Adds:
  • Hosted dashboard accessible from any device.
  • Monday digest email.
  • Weekly budget with alert at 80 % of your limit.
  • Slack totals reporting.
  • Support for up to three machines.
  • Nothing leaves your machine unless you enable the hosted dashboard.
  • No monthly fee; the $9/month option is also available if you prefer a subscription.

FAQ

What does the Pro license enable that the free version doesn’t? It provides a hosted, always‑available dashboard, weekly budget alerts at 80 % usage, Slack totals and the ability to use Pro on three separate machines.

Do I need to pay anything else after the $49 purchase? No. The $49 lifetime payment covers all current Pro features for the lifetime of the product.

Can I try Pro before buying? You can install the full toolkit for free and test the local hooks and replay command. The hosted dashboard and multi‑machine support are only available after purchase.

Buy the Tokentrim Pro lifetime license now
